question: As per Union Budget 2021, 9% of the government revenue will be spent on _______.
solution:
The correct answer is **__Centrally sponsored schemes.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• As per Union Budget 2021, 9% of the government revenue will be spent on a **Centrally sponsored scheme.**
 
• Recently, the Minister of Finance presented the Union Budget 2021-22. This was the first-ever **digital Union Budget**.
 
• It is based on** six** pillars-
 
 
• Health and well-being.
 
• Physical and Financial capital and Infrastructure.
 
• Inclusive Development for Aspirational India.
 
• Reinvigorating Human capital.
 
• Innovation and R&D.
 
• Minimum Government, Maximum Governance.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__** 

__
 
• Father of Indian Budget - P. C. Mahalanobis.
 
• Current Union Finance Minister - Nirmala Sitaraman.
 
• Article 112 - Annual Financial Statement.
 
• The Union Finance Minister to present the maximum number of budgets - Moraji Desai (10 times).
 
• The first budget of the Republic of India was presented by John Mathai on 28th February 1950.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Constitution refers to the Budget as the '**Annual Financial Statement**'.
 
• The budget is laid before Parliament in the name of the President.
 
• The central ministry decided to merge the General Budget and the** Railway Budget on 21st September 2016.**
 
• The General Budget has a total of **109 demands** (**103 for civil expenditure and 6 for defence expenditure**).
 
• The Railway Budget has 32 demands. The Union Finance Minister presents the Union Budget every year in the Parliament that contains the Government of India revenue and expenditure for one fiscal year which begins on **1st April and ends on 31st March of the following year.**
 
• India's first Union Budget was presented by the** first Finance minister, RK Shanmukham Chetty on November 26, 1947.**
 
• Former Prime Minister** Indira Gandhi was the first Indian woman Finance minister **to have presented the budget in her capacity as the Prime Minister of India in **1978.**
 
• **C. D. Deshmukh was India's first Governor of RBI to have presented the interim Budget for the year (1951-1952)**.
 
• The budget of** 1973-1974** is known as the** 'Black Budget' **due to the budget deficit.
 
• **Stages of Enacting the budget**
 
 
• Presentation of the budget.
 
• General discussion.
 
• Scrutiny by departmentally related standing committees.
 
• Voting on demands for grants.
 
• Passing of Appropriation Bill (Article 114).
 
• Passing of Finance Bill.
